question: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?

observed_information.statement: A cockpit display warns of an engine failure before a small robot with glowing eyes and a floating panel appears on a dark rocky surface.
A dark-haired astronaut exits a landed spacecraft onto the rocky surface while wearing a suit.
A large mech walks toward the robot while an explosion occurs and the dark-haired astronaut braces nearby.
A light-skinned astronaut runs through smoke while the dark-haired astronaut looks shocked.
The dark-haired astronaut kneels, looks up defiantly, then stands facing the light-skinned astronaut.
Three identical astronauts walk forward across the terrain, led by the front figure.
The lead astronaut stops and turns back while the trailing astronauts continue moving forward.
Buzz Lightyear confronts an older astronaut with a serious expression.
Three astronauts walk across a dark rocky terrain toward a lit structure.
A green-suited astronaut, a black-suited astronaut, and a small robot walk down a spaceship corridor.
The black-suited astronaut gestures near a yellow mech while talking to the green-suited astronaut.
Buzz stops as a large armored mech rises in a red-lit room.
A device projecting a green crystal hologram activates and reveals a man in a green spacesuit.
A grey-haired man activates a console machine while another character watches.
An older astronaut examines a photograph held by a robotic arm and shifts from neutral to shocked.

working_relations.statement: Both videos show three astronauts walking across dark rocky terrain toward a glowing or lit structure, suggesting a shared journey state between the beginning and ending.
Both videos place astronauts near a small robot and a large mech, leaving the robot/mech relationship with the astronauts unresolved.

The beginning shows explosion and smoke around a mech/robot encounter, while the ending shows console activation and a suspended mechanical platform, suggesting machine-related escalation without a visible cause.

The beginning shows identical astronauts and a confrontation between two astronauts, while the ending shows Buzz confronting an older astronaut and a crystal-revealed green-suited man, suggesting unresolved identity and relationship links.
